query.description: The query as it was received, unmodified.

resolved.description: The exact in-game name, set only when the query matched exactly one weapon. Empty otherwise — never a guess picked from several candidates.

match_count.description: How many weapons the query matched.

candidates.description: Every weapon the query matched, in name order. Ask the user which one they meant; do not choose.

ambiguous.description: True when the query matched more than one weapon, and no answer about a single weapon can follow.

catalog_size.description: How many weapons the dataset holds, so a caller can see how narrow the coverage is.
